main.description: The account signs the payload whose keyed digest is given, in the given namespace. The key (a random per-signature salt) travels with the signature, not in this record.

namespace.description: What kind of payload is signed. `git`: a Git object without its signature, as Git hands it to its signing program.

algorithm.description: How `digest` is computed. `hmac-sha256`: HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the signature's 32-byte salt, over the exact payload bytes.

digest.description: The keyed digest, under `algorithm`, of the exact payload bytes.

createdAt.description: Required. When the signer signed, to the second, by the signer's own clock.
